name: aip-oss-platform
description: TAKT-supervised development of a modular OSS platform inspired by Palantir AIP/Foundry capabilities.

scripts.platform:autonomous: takt --workflow platform-lifecycle --task "PRODUCT_GOAL.md を正本として、受入条件を弱めず、機械検証と独立レビューを通してプラットフォームを完成させてください。"
scripts.verify:mechanism: node scripts/platform-control.mjs run-stage mechanism && node scripts/platform-control.mjs validate mechanism
scripts.check: npm test && npm run takt:doctor && npm run verify:mechanism
